basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer | Agentic AI in Production | Founder, Anand Creations FDE Practice
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who already runs this exact model: I founded Anand Creations to embed inside customer environments and ship production agentic AI from discovery to go-live, no handoff. Currently embedded at LumApps, I lead technical delivery end-to-end: agent architecture, prompts, tool calls, and integration with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, and product data, shipping a system that doubles outbound conversions and forecasts $1M in quarterly revenue. At Beekeeper I led complex technical deliveries as Tech Lead, replaced a $337K vendor contract with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks, and mentored the AI engineering cohort into engineers who now lead features independently. Fluent across Python, TypeScript, and Java, with 13+ years shipping production systems for 10M+ users.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Forward deployed engagement of Anand Creations: embedded directly with LumApps to own AI transformation end-to-end, from production agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, grounded in Salesforce CRM data as the base data source, with agent intelligence design, prompts, reasoning, and tool calls exposed over MCP servers, agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Built and integrated a data pipeline unifying 5+ customer data sources (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j with event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub and a per-agent query and write-back contract, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Led complex technical deliveries and mentored the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to CIO. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.

Built customer-facing analytics dashboards on Snowflake, BigQuery, and Looker, giving org admins direct visibility into their own organization's usage and engagement data, the same deployment-health and business-outcome reporting a customer-facing agent rollout needs.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks, from proof of concept to production. 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Hired for craft and curiosity, grew engineers who now lead features independently.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Built reliability in from day one, enabling enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a showcase at CES Las Vegas.

publications.summary: How verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and draft-before-send patterns keep an autonomous agent from shipping wrong actions to real customers.

RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, Salesforce Agentforce delivery org, Zurich (office-based). Leads a delivery pod building agentic AI solutions inside enterprise customer environments end-to-end: architecture, prompts, tool calls, integration, data pipelines (Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks), KPI dashboards, PoC to MVP in days, mentoring junior engineers. Requires 7+ years software/technical delivery experience, customer-facing consulting/professional services/FDE background, fluency in 2+ of Python/TypeScript/Java/Apex, deep LLM and prompt engineering experience, ~25% travel. Nice-to-haves: Salesforce platform certifications, LangChain/LlamaIndex familiarity, Snowflake/Databricks/BigQuery expertise.
_jobApplication.notes: Near-perfect fit: candidate literally runs a forward deployed engineering practice (Anand Creations) and is embedded in an FDE engagement at LumApps right now, shipping agentic AI to production with the same architecture-to-deployed-and-observable lifecycle the JD describes. Confirmed with candidate: comfortable with the ~25% travel expectation. Added real Snowflake/BigQuery/Looker experience (customer-facing org-admin analytics dashboards at Beekeeper), closing that nice-to-have gap. Remaining honest gaps: no Apex and no Salesforce platform certifications (Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist, Architect-level); both are nice-to-haves, not must-haves (must-have language fluency is already satisfied by Python/TypeScript/Java), so not fabricated or a blocker.
